translations.answer: HumanPlus connects human shadowing, robot demonstration collection, and egocentric visual imitation in one pipeline. The system depends on a customized H1, a fixed Euler-angle retargeting map, specific cameras, and bounded task settings; it demonstrates pipeline feasibility, not calibration-free transfer to arbitrary robots and environments.
translations.applicability.assumptions.0: Human pose estimation, the fixed Euler-angle map, and the customized H1 morphology have each been calibrated.
translations.applicability.assumptions.1: Latency, occlusion, and camera pose remain within the paper's tested range.
translations.applicability.controllers.0: Humanoid Shadowing Transformer and ACT visuomotor imitation policy
translations.applicability.environments.0: Indoor human shadowing, robot demonstration collection, and short-horizon visual tasks
translations.applicability.simulators.0: Isaac Gym training and physical-hardware deployment
translations.confidence_rationale: The paper provides the system design, official implementation, user study, and hardware-task results. The number of participants and trials, camera viewpoint, customized morphology, and sitting bypass limit generalization.
translations.evidence.0.locator: Sections 3-5, Figures 2-8, Tables 1-3, and the appendix
translations.evidence.0.note: Describes HST, the fixed human-to-robot map, data collection, ACT imitation, and bounded hardware evaluation.
translations.evidence.0.title: HumanPlus: Humanoid Shadowing and Imitation from Humans
translations.title: Does HumanPlus provide a calibration-free, general human-shadowing and visual-skill system that transfers directly to any humanoid?
